headline: Turkish defense firm Dasal delivers Sumru surveillance drone
summary: Dasal delivered its 'Sumru' lightweight surveillance drone, designed for setup within 7 minutes and 2.5 hours of continuous flight without a runway.
why: Dasal is a Turkish defense technology joint venture producing uncrewed aerial vehicle systems.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Defense equipment deliveries boost domestic defense hardware inventory.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
